parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment is a question that asks whether the network may have trouble handling large noise, given that performance degrades faster with increasing noise. This is an implicit action, as it is not a direct suggestion but rather a clarification request. The comment merely poses a question and does not tell the authors what concrete modification to make; the authors would have to infer on their own how to respond (e.g., whether to add experiments, adjust the method, or discuss limitations), so the action is vague in terms of how to apply it. The comment does not explicitly ask the authors to analyze anything specific or provide any implementation details, so claiming the authors know exactly what to do is an unsupported inference. The comment contains only an implicitly stated action that lacks detail on how to carry it out, which matches the rubric level describing an implicit but vague action, not the level requiring an implicit action with concrete implementation guidance.
